_comment: WP-G3B ROUND-2 served config of f_bwd2 (PREREGISTRATION_BWD.md B10 D7 / B10.2 / B11.1): the round-1 CP1 form F5b-1+jmax at f0_bwd 1600 MHz and the round-1 ring block, composed with the round-2 attribution (compose_bwd_r2_lib.BwdComposerR2: shares per geometry {'llama3_70b': 0.3998038979, 'qwen3_30b': 0.9168873725, 'qwen3_5_397b': 0.9517138407}, static once per pack, X = cp x g0(head_dim) {'128': 28.0, '256': 36.8}, no tail term) at the CP group's median attention-phase clock; the d256 16K cp16 under-prediction (-11 / -15 % on the two round-2 allocations) is a DECLARED KNOWN LIMIT; the per-rank-attention composition is the frozen alternative scored alongside; every setting is a named field, never selected on sealed rows

clock_input.f_crit_rule: the kernel clock of a sealed row = the MEDIAN over the CP group's ranks of the card's attention-phase clock (D2 (i)); the heater f_crit is recorded; CP1 rows: the lane's own attention-phase clock
clock_input.flag_rule: B11.1: rows whose group-median attention clock is >= 1750 MHz are FLAGGED in the verdict (not corrected); the per-rank-attention and B11 fields are scored alongside

kernel_law.formula: k(f) = tile f0/f + (1 - lambda) C f0/f + lambda C; tile = tau x chain tiles (+ tau_jmax J_max), C = k0 + b_S S + tau rho n_chain + static(n) (U excluded)

clock_input.scorer_rule: score_holdout_bwd.py --clock-cards: joins the card per row, takes the field's clock quantity from its split (group median | per-rank attention | B11), applies kernel_f0 x (f0 / f) + ring (the structural law's split), served_f0 alongside
clock_input.two_term_s_source: hardware profile clock.two_term_s_bwd (B1.1 (report 01b, 2026-10-06): least squares on the log ratios of the 96 kernel-level NOCOMM flash_bprop pairs of probe B1 (hsg 7756270, llama3_70b-p4096-cp4, arm a duty 19 ~1465 MHz vs arm d light ~1938 MHz per rank, same kernel / rank / backward step); s_bwd = 0.664 +- 0.015 at f0_bwd = 1600 MHz; comm + nocomm 0.724; LS alpha 0.65 (reader alpha_kernel 0.764); one d128 cell, one clock lever - the d256 reading is open (no light nsys arm on qwen3_5_397b 16K))

extracted_from.rule: every top-level key; settings reduced to the served setting s4bwd2 (settings_all = the 7 names)

served_h_bwd2.json.note: the same served setting and r2 block; differs in item / _comment

the d256 CP1 P90 (period-4 wave quantization)
round2.shares_known_limit: PB B10.2 (c) / B11: the per-step shares of the shared constants (k0, b_S q_phys, tau rho n_chain) are served as per-(hardware, geometry) CONSTANTS without a mechanism: the per-term read on the 2c-R2-cov cells (23_diag_b10_lanes.md) found the share NOT a geometry property (within-geometry spread over the families 0.16-0.52) and the term paid short differing by geometry; the kv-head ordering of the pooled shares (2 -> 0.91, 4 -> 0.59, 8 -> 0.36) is a 3-point ordering, not evidence - a KNOWN LIMIT of the round-2 model
round2.shares_mode: NOT converged (spread 0.552 > 0.15): per-geometry shares (B10 D1 (i) SHARED rule: per-geometry constants of the same form)

x_g0_alternative.source: x_structure_bwd.json of the served run (round-1 + cov + d256 lanes); the frozen alternative setting r2_x_g0_served_run

round2.x_g0_source: --x-g0 pin (B10.2 (a) / B11: g0 d256 from the two 16K cp16 allocations)

kernel_law.formula: k(f) = tile f0/f + (1 - lambda) C f0/f + lambda C; tile = tau x chain tiles (+ tau_jmax J_max), C = k0 + b_S S + tau rho n_chain + static(n) (U excluded)

clock.note: PB B6 / B10.2: the ring block's structural law pre-splits every kernel entry (tile + (1 - lambda) C scaled under alpha 1, lambda C unscaled); the kernel clock = the CP group's median attention-phase clock (D2 (i)); readings >= 1750 MHz FLAGGED (B11.1), never corrected
